summary: Phase 2 testing complete. Backend: 31/31 pytest cases pass (12 new Phase-2 tests covering verify-email happy/invalid/reuse paths, resend-verification (auth + already_verified), forgot-password anti-enumeration + Mongo token insert, reset-password success + new-login + token-reuse rejection, admin gating (403 for non-admin, 200 + correct shape for admin), admin/users hiding password_hash, signup-resilience no-5xx). Frontend: /forgot-password renders and shows forgot-sent card; /reset-password?token=... shows two pw inputs + mismatch error + invalid-token error; /verify-email?token=bad shows 'Couldn't verify — invalid or already-used link'; login page has login-forgot-link → /forgot-password; Account verify-banner + verify-resend-btn work and button text flips to 'Sent ✓'; /admin redirects non-admin to /app; admin login sees Admin header link, /admin loads KPI cards (kpi-total-users testid added), 30-day signups SVG bar chart, recent payments table, admin-users-table with 10 entries. Phase 1 regression intact.

ui_bugs.issue: KPI() destructured only {label,value,sub} and never forwarded data-testid to the root div, so kpi-total-users testid was missing from the DOM. Spec required it. Fixed in this iteration.

issues: Other KPI cards (Free/Paid/Revenue) and the 30-day bar chart could also use data-testid attributes for future regression. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_issue_verification_email is awaited inline inside POST /auth/signup. Resend SDK call is offloaded to asyncio.to_thread (good), but if Resend ever hangs >30s it will stall signup. Consider asyncio.create_task to truly fire-and-forget, or shorten the resend HTTP timeout.

server.py:/auth/forgot-password — when user.auth_provider=='google' we silently skip token creation. That's fine for anti-enumeration on the API, but the UI offers no hint; google users who try reset will get a generic 'Dispatched' card and never receive anything. Consider a small disclaimer on /forgot-password.

server.py:/admin/stats signups_30d uses cutoff as ISO-string comparison against the stringified created_at field. Works because ISO-8601 sorts lexically, but a created_at saved without timezone (older accounts) could silently drop out. Consider migrating created_at to a real BSON Date.
AdminDashboard.jsx — only one KPI carries data-testid; consider also kpi-free/paid/revenue and chart-signups-30d for richer e2e.
emails.py — send_email swallows all exceptions including programming errors (KeyError in template). That's intentional but worth a sentry/metric counter when this goes to prod.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v` — all 31 pass. backend_test.py uses pymongo direct read of db.email_tokens (MONGO_URL+DB_NAME from env) to fetch verify/reset tokens since Resend sandbox cannot deliver to test emails. Admin login works with credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Phase-2 frontend testids verified: forgot-sent, login-forgot-link, verify-banner, verify-resend-btn, header-admin-link, kpi-total-users, admin-users-table, admin-error. Stripe real-payment path still NOT exercised (only session creation). The webhook bad-sig test still produces a noisy KeyError traceback in backend.err.log — that is from emergentintegrations.StripeCheckout.handle_webhook raising on the parsed-but-typeless body; the route correctly converts it to a 400.
rca of the issue: Single low-priority bug found: AdminDashboard's KPI() helper component didn't spread/forward data-testid → only label/value/sub were destructured. Result: the spec-required kpi-total-users testid was absent from rendered DOM, even though visually the card existed. Fixed by adding `'data-testid': testId` to the destructure and passing it to the root div.
